name: zagreb-bike-navigator
description: Biciklistička navigacija za Grad Zagreb – OpenStreetMap + otvoreni podaci Grada Zagreba (data.gov.hr)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:https -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
